newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Zlatorog to list shares on OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Zlatorog to list shares on OTC market.

text.p: Slovenian trading company Zlatorog d.d. will list its shares on the over-the-counter (OTC) market of the Ljubljana bourse from November 7, the bourse said on Tuesday.
The company will list 209,610 shares with a nominal value of 10,000 tolars each, representing 100 percent of its equity.
Zlatorog joins a batch of 21 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the main or OTC markets of the Ljubljana bourse since the beginning of this year.
The bourse said it expects up to 14 other newly privatised companies to be listed by the end of the year.
